memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: episodic vertigo triggered by head movement, nausea mild, Dix-Hallpike positive on right.
  - Plan: start betahistine 16 mg BD, meclizine 25 mg SOS for acute episodes, advise vestibular rehab, review in 8 weeks.
- Sciatica
  - Status: right leg pain radiating below knee, straight leg raise positive 60°, paresthesia in L5 distribution.
  - Plan: start pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, arrange lumbar MRI, review in 6 weeks.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 92 kg, waist 102 cm (>90 cm cut-off), BMI 31.2.
  - Plan: start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, diet advice: breakfast - high protein, low carb; lunch - portion-controlled veg; dinner - light soup, check liver enzymes in 3 months, review weight monthly.
Due: HbA1c 2025-07-10

memories.text: Lumbar spine MRI (plain) – shows L4‑L5 disc bulge with mild right foraminal narrowing, no cord compression, degenerative changes at L3‑L4. Correlation: matches clinical radiculopathy in L5 distribution.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: vertigo rare (<1 episode/month), meclizine used once last month.
  - Plan: continue betahistine 16 mg BD, stop meclizine PRN, advise to resume if symptoms return.
- Sciatica

  - Plan: continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, diclofenac 50 mg BD after food, continue physiotherapy, consider tapering diclofenac if pain-free for 4 weeks.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Messaged via clinic app: ‘I’ve been feeling a bit light‑headed when I stand up quickly, especially in the mornings. My ears feel a bit blocked. Should I be concerned?’

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pure‑tone audiometry – bilateral mild high‑frequency hearing loss (4‑8 kHz thresholds 30‑35 dB), speech discrimination 92%. No conductive component. Findings consistent with age‑related presbycusis, not explaining vertigo.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Benign positional vertigo
  - Status: light‑headedness on standing improved after increasing fluid intake, no true vertigo spells.
  - Plan: continue betahistine 16 mg BD, advise salt moderation, monitor orthostatic symptoms.
- Sciatica
  - Status: pain‑free for 3 weeks, straight leg raise 90°.
  - Plan: taper diclofenac to 25 mg BD after food for 2 weeks then stop, continue pregabalin 75 mg BD, continue physiotherapy home program.
- Obesity
  - Status: weight 83 kg, waist 90 cm (at male cut‑off).
  - Plan: continue orlistat, diet: add legumes, reduce saturated fat, maintain activity, check liver enzymes.
Due: HbA1c 2026-05-01

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Liver function test: ALT 22 U/L (<40), AST 20 U/L (<40), ALP 75 U/L (<120), GGT 28 U/L (<50), Bilirubin 0.7 mg/dL (<1.2). Orlistat well tolerated.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Referral to Physiotherapy Department, Sri Jayadeva Institute for Cardiovascular Sciences, Bengaluru. Reason: persistent lumbar radiculopathy despite medication, need core strengthening and lumbar traction. Requested 6 sessions over 8 weeks, report back on pain and functional status.
